question: A is the brother of B. B is the sister of C. D is the mother of A. E is the father of C. How is D related to E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854e449acd75259b0fdb6ee8f851931989fac9f98d9eedc211a9f6a75ae54a7d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3c98544a6263f276e3676a73d4cd2f4627ff98055ffe76a63ceab95104c5993.png] 

 

⇒ A and B are siblings.

⇒ B and C are siblings.

⇒ Therefore A, B, C are siblings.

⇒ D is the mother of A ⇒ D is the mother of A, B, C.

⇒ E is the father of C ⇒ E is the father of A, B, C.

⇒ Hence D and E are parents of the same children.

**∴ D is the Wife** of E.

Hence the correct answer is** Option 1.**
